name: Sovol SV05 Klipper 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; set bed temp
M104 S150 ; warm the nozzle without oozing
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; wait for bed temp
G28 ; home all axes
START_PRINT BED_TEMP=[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] EXTRUDER_TEMP=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; printer.cfg macro, skipped by Klipper when it isn't defined
SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO TOTAL_LAYER=[total_layer_count]
G90 ; use absolute coordinates
M83 ; extruder relative mode
G1 Z50 F240
G1 X2 Y10 F3000
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; wait for nozzle temp
G1 Z0.28 F240
G92 E0
G1 Y140 E10 F1500 ; prime the nozzle
G1 X2.3 F5000
G92 E0
G1 Y10 E10 F1200 ; prime the nozzle
G92 E0
machine_end_gcode:
{if max_layer_z < printable_height}G1 Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+2, printable_height)} F600 ; move print head up{endif}
G1 X5 Y{print_bed_max[1]*0.8} F{travel_speed*60} ; present print
END_PRINT ; printer.cfg macro, skipped by Klipper when it isn't defined
M140 S0 ; turn off heatbed
M104 S0 ; turn off nozzle
M107 ; turn off fan
M84 ; disable motors
